sdt.defaultBaseBranch.description: Base branch used when reviewing the current local branch.

sdt.language.description: Free-form language hint appended to every LLM prompt (e.g. "en", "ja", "zh", "Español"). Applies to summaries, flow narratives, Q&A answers.

sdt.flowMaxTurns.description: Cap on agent turns for Flow planning and refinement. The default 5 fits the preloaded-code approach — the primary source is embedded in the prompt, so the model rarely needs to Grep. Raise it only when a very large perspective still needs on-the-fly exploration. Ignored when trace depth is 'normal' (that mode always runs single-turn).

sdt.traceDepth.markdownDescription: How much source each perspective's Summary and Trace ask gets to see. `normal` sends only the diff hunks and runs a single-turn ask with no tools — fast and cheap. `deep` also preloads the primary files (full or hunk-sliced) and enables Grep. The toggle in the Perspectives view header overrides this setting for the current session.

sdt.claudeExecutable.description: Absolute path to the claude CLI. Leave empty to search PATH and the standard Claude Code install locations.

sdt.environmentVariables.markdownDescription: Extra environment variables passed to the spawned Claude CLI, merged over the extension host's own env (settings win on conflict). Each entry is `{ "name": "VAR", "value": "..." }`. OAuth logins need nothing here — `~/.claude/.credentials.json` is loaded regardless. Use it for Vertex/Bedrock (`CLAUDE_CODE_USE_VERTEX`, `ANTHROPIC_VERTEX_PROJECT_ID`, `AWS_*`) or for pinning `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` at the extension level. `~/.claude/settings.json` is never loaded, so `apiKeyHelper` and its `env` block do not take effect — put the values here directly.

sdt.claudeModel.markdownDescription: Model the Claude Agent SDK uses. `default` leaves the SDK/CLI default in place; `inherit` uses whatever the ambient claude CLI is configured for.
